title: FLA->SWF static text: title renders left-aligned & wrong glyphs (font substitution)
description: Discovered via Ruffle render of published golden.fla (apps/desktop/e2e/golden-fla-oracle.spec.ts) vs reference golden.swf. The 'Test Game' title DefineText renders LEFT-aligned and with overlapping/garbled glyphs; golden renders it CENTERED and clean. Two root causes: (1) X-OFFSET LOST: golden's title TextRecord has x_offset=3640 twips (centres the text in its box) with bounds x=3651..7713; ours emits x_offset=0, bounds x=0..4139 -> text sits at the left edge. (2) FONT SUBSTITUTION: golden embeds DefineFont2 'Arial' (id=3) and the TextRecord uses Arial glyph INDICES [4,7,13,14,0,2,...]; we emit a NotoSans DefineFont (id=4) but REUSE those same Arial glyph indices, so the wrong glyphs render (NotoSans glyph order != Arial). We must either embed glyphs matching the referenced indices/font, or remap indices to our font. Also glyph advances differ (golden Arial [387,400,400,240,200,560]; ours NotoSans [316,406,345,260,460,524]) causing spacing/overlap. ACCEPTANCE: published golden title renders centred, correct glyphs, matching golden.swf render (golden-fla-oracle.spec.ts visual). Files: packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts (text import, x-offset/registration), packages/swf/src/text.ts + fonts.ts (DefineText/DefineFont encoding). Related learnings: CLAUDE.md SWF encoding 'Embedded font glyphs'. Found during golden parity work (1190/1191).
